info.title: Configuration API
info.description: Manage applications, sources, source properties, managed tags and managed tag values. Lists use forward-only keyset pagination with after and limit (default 50, maximum 200). Successful responses return resource data directly, with ForwardPage (items, after, totalCount) for lists. Errors use ProblemDetails. Tenant identity comes from authentication. Application updates replace settings and require the latest etag. Secrets are returned only on creation. Property changes and source deletion may complete asynchronously.

get.description: Filter by case-insensitive name containment, type (Generic or Media), status (Active or Purging), createdFrom/createdTo and updatedFrom/updatedTo (inclusive timestamps). Filters combine with AND and retain application resource restrictions. Preserve filters when following after cursors.

Retry-After.description: Optional number of seconds to wait before retrying.

get.description: Filter by case-insensitive name containment, case-sensitive tags (repeat tags to require every tag), createdFrom/createdTo and updatedFrom/updatedTo (inclusive timestamps), createdBy and updatedBy (actor IDs). Filters combine with AND. Preserve filters when following after cursors.

Retry-After.description: Optional number of seconds to wait before retrying.

put.description: Replaces metadata and access selections. Supply etag from the latest read; a stale value returns 409. Omitted collections become empty.

get.description: Filter by case-insensitive name containment, type, parentId and inclusive createdFrom/createdTo or updatedFrom/updatedTo timestamps. Filters combine with AND. Keep filters when following after cursors; results are ordered by ID.

Retry-After.description: Optional number of seconds to wait before retrying.

put.description: Replaces displayName and parentId. The type is immutable. Omitting parentId or setting it to null removes the parent and clears existing value parent links; changing it also clears those links.

Retry-After.description: Optional number of seconds to wait before retrying.

delete.summary: Delete a managed tag and its values
delete.description: Returns 409 while referenced by a card definition. Detaches child lists. Returns 204 if the managed tag is already absent.

Retry-After.description: Optional number of seconds to wait before retrying.

get.description: Filter by case-sensitive key containment and exact parentKey. Keep filters when following after cursors; results are ordered by key.

Retry-After.description: Optional number of seconds to wait before retrying.

post.description: Supply exactly one of value.singleValue or value.localizedValue, matching the managed tag type. parentKey refers to a value in the same managed tag. Returns 409 for an existing key.

Retry-After.description: Optional number of seconds to wait before retrying.
Optional number of seconds to wait before retrying.

put.description: Replaces value, order and parentKey. Supply exactly one value representation matching the managed tag type. The key is immutable; a missing key returns 404.

Retry-After.description: Optional number of seconds to wait before retrying.

delete.description: Clears parent links to this value within its managed tag. Returns 204 if the key is already absent.

Retry-After.description: Optional number of seconds to wait before retrying.

UpdateApplicationRequest.description: Replaces all application settings. Etag must match the latest GET response.

UpdateSourceRequest.description: Omitted or null fields are unchanged. An empty description clears it.

UpsertSourcePropertyRequest.description: Upserts property metadata. Null optional fields preserve existing values; empty description clears it.
